verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted inference engine. It installs via pip/uv, ships an official Docker image, and runs on a wide range of hardware, so the operator decides where it runs and where prompts and outputs live. This residency control is only implied by self-hosting; the evidence never addresses data storage location or residency directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation on data residency or where data is stored and persisted, any region-selection guidance, and independent corroboration of residency control.
